page.overview:
Who is Niv Drendow Apruk?

Niv Drendow Apruk was an Umbaran male scientist who served as a member of the Nihil during the High Republic Era. He was a protégé of Ithorian Apruk eventually took on his own protégé, Driggit Parse, though she abandoned Apruk in favor of the tutelage of the Nihil commander known as "The Warden".

At the age of five, Apruk was taken from a school for young geniuses by Boolan and brought to Boolan's hideout on Vrant Tarnum, where Apruk was raised and instructed in Boolan's ways. Apruk attempted to search for Parse on Eriadu, but caught Jedi Master Emerick Caphtor on the way. Hoping to discover more about the Nameless from Caphtor, he brought the Jedi to the Kharvashark Ruins on Vrant Tarnum, where the two deciphered Boolan's decades of research on the Nameless. Using access to Jedi Azlin Rell's journal as a bargaining chip, Caphtor convinced Apruk to abandon the Nihil and surrender himself to Republic custody.

Niv Drendow Apruk first appeared in Escape from Valo, a 2024 junior novel written by Daniel José Older and Alyssa Wong as part of the Star Wars: The High Republic multimedia project's Wong described Apruk as their "terrible son" and also enjoys the character's double first name. He was originally going to be named Veet, and later Nive Drendow Apruk, before receiving the final name Niv Drendow Apruk.
